title: No MCP server — code is a plain Go library, not an MCP protocol server
evidence: server/*.go declare `package server` (server.go:1, data.go:2); no `package main`/`func main` anywhere (grep across run = 0 hits); go.mod requires only mock/uuid/testify/x/exp — no MCP SDK; grep for mcp|jsonrpc|stdio|RegisterTool|CallTool|ListTools|InputSchema|modelcontextprotocol matches ONLY comments (server.go:8,10,15; data.go:1). The `Server` type (server.go:11) exposes ~40 typed Go methods, not registered MCP tools with an entrypoint/transport.
suggestion: Add a `package main` entrypoint that registers each capability as an MCP tool over a JSON-RPC/stdio transport using an MCP server SDK.

title: Competition filter exists but is unreliable and not exposed as a match-listing query
evidence: A competition filter IS present and wired in: extractCompetition (query.go:629) parses Brasileirao/Copa do Brasil/Libertadores; GetTeamStatsForCompetition (server.go:260) and calculateLeagueTable (query.go:428) thread a `competition` arg through matchBelongsToCompetition (query.go:500) / GetTeamStats (data.go:791). BUT the filter is broken for 2 of the 3 named competitions: matchBelongsToCompetition infers Brasileirao purely from Season 2003-2019 over the merged getAllMatches() set (query.go:419), and matches Copa do Brasil / Libertadores only via the Tournament field — which is set ONLY for BR-Football-Dataset (data.go:392); the dedicated Libertadores loader sets Stage, not Tournament (data.go:363), so a 'Libertadores' or 'Copa do Brasil' competition filter selects NOTHING from those slices. No tool returns 'all matches in competition X' — the filter only lives inside team-stats and league-table aggregation.
suggestion: Tag each Match with its source competition at load time (the data is already partitioned into per-competition slices) and filter on that tag; expose a GetMatchesByCompetition query.

title: Competition-membership, biggest-wins, best-home-record and league-table logic duplicated between Server and QueryEngine
evidence: matchBelongsToCompetition (query.go:500) is copied as matchBelongsToCompetitionForStore (data.go:1164); GetBiggestWins/GetBestHomeRecord/GetStatisticalAnalysis (server.go:131,185,79) duplicate handleBiggestWinsQuery/handleBestHomeRecordQuery/handleAverageGoalsQuery (query.go:312,360,267).
suggestion: Consolidate the shared aggregation into one code path shared by both facades.
